flows:
Navigate to https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ then Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in the browser.
Look at the verdict banner at the top of the report page.
Assert A verdict banner is shown at the top of the page.
Assert The banner says "All 8 claims are true. This README told the truth.".
Get The full visible text of the verdict banner at the top of the report page and save as {{banner_text}}.

remark: wait: PRIMARY: verdict banner at the top of the report page; role=heading; text="All 8
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'The full visible text of the verdict banner at the top
assert: A verdict banner is shown at the top of the page.
assert: The banner says "All 8 claims are true. This README told the truth.".
